channel.title: Khadija Zaman — SEO & AI Search Field Notes
channel.description: Practical writing on SEO, AI search visibility (GEO/AEO), semantic content strategy, and marketing automation.

item.title: Central Entity in SEO: What Google’s “Identifying Topical Entities” Patent Actually Describes
item.description: How Google’s Identifying Topical Entities patent application confirms a page’s main topic, and how a central entity anchors a topical map.

item.title: Topic Cluster Architecture That Actually Scales Organic Traffic
item.description: Publishing more rarely fixes a plateau — fragmented architecture does. How to structure pillars, clusters, and internal links so authority concentrates.

item.title: How to Get Your Brand Cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity
item.description: Ranking #1 in Google no longer guarantees you appear in an AI answer — the systems judge content differently. A checklist to make pages retrieval-ready.

item.title: SEO vs AEO vs GEO: What Each One Actually Means, and How to Sequence Them
item.description: SEO, AEO, and GEO are layers, not rivals. A working definition of each, where they genuinely diverge, and the order to build them so the work compounds.
